data.narrative: On 2026-04-09, a spoofed regulatory directive purporting to be FinCEN Emergency Order EO-2026-0409-001 was received, instructing immediate account freezes. The directive exhibited multiple indicators of fraud, including invalid digital signature, non-standard formatting, and unauthorized sender domain. Internal validation protocols confirmed the order as fraudulent. No customer accounts were impacted.
